title: Dvoyanka
summary: The dvoyanka is a Bulgarian double flute: two pipes in one block with a single beak, one carrying the melody with finger holes and the other sounding beside it. The wood is pale and burnt with red zigzags, and the two voices blend into a soft, doubled tone.
howToPlay: A covered hole glows; an open hole shows its dark bore. Seven notes of the mode are lit down the melody pipe on the left.
Each strike shows the fingering of that note and a band of breath runs from the beak to it.
The second pipe sounds along with the melody.
rules: A phrase is a line of notes, each struck close to its beat.
Long notes swell slowly: strike on the beat and let them ring.
The round ends when the last note has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: It is a shepherd's and village instrument, played for dances and for company.
